# DataGridPresentation

`Flare.Components.DataGridPresentation`

How FlareDataGrid presents its records at the current width.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Table` | `0` | The ordinary table. This is the default and preserves the existing behavior. |
| `Stacked` | `1` | A compact presentation: each row becomes a record, each cell carries its column title, and the table header becomes a compact control bar. Sorting, filtering, selection and virtualization keep working. |
| `Auto` | `2` | Uses Stacked while the grid's own width is below FlareDataGrid.PresentationBreakpoint, and Table at or above it. |

## Used by components

- `FlareDataGrid`
